name: thirtyfive
description: 35 — a drop-and-merge number puzzle. Static web app, wrapped for iOS with Capacitor.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/ && cp -R css js img fonts www/ && node tools/stamp.js
scripts.site: rm -rf site && mkdir -p site && cp index.html site/ && cp -R css js img fonts site/ && cp web/privacy.html web/site.css web/site.js site/ && cp store/play/icon-512.png site/icon.png && node tools/stamp.js site
scripts.android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" npx cap open ios
scripts.sync: npm run build && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" npx cap sync ios
